records.source_span: My name is Lukas Varga, a runway model based in Berlin with Slovak-Hungarian roots. Outside of work, I enjoy cycling along quiet river paths, practicing yoga, and experimenting with black-and-white photography. I follow a mostly plant-based diet and keep an active lifestyle, mindful of my family's history of heart health concerns.
records.value: Family history of heart health concerns
records.claim: Lukas Varga is mindful of his family's history of heart health concerns.

records.source_span: Lately, I've been feeling strangely disconnected from my own work — almost as if the energy I usually pour into the runway has dulled a little. In the evenings, I find myself just sitting in the loft, streaming these quiet, obscure short films online, hoping one of them might spark something, but the spark hasn't quite returned.
records.value: Experiencing a creative lull; feeling disconnected from runway work; watching independent short films seeking inspiration
records.claim: Lukas Varga is currently experiencing a creative lull and feeling disconnected from his runway work, and has been watching independent short films in the evenings seeking inspiration.

records.source_span: Last winter, I found myself pacing the length of my loft more often than I walked any runway. The city outside felt still, muted, as if someone had draped the streets in the same soft greys as the coats I used to wear on cold show mornings. My days were filled with screens—small boxes of faces and garments that never moved beyond two dimensions. I adjusted the lighting in my apartment like a set designer, hoping it would grant a sense of presence. But without the whisper of fabric in motion, the subtle exchange between model and audience, something essential seemed to slip from my grasp.
records.value: Experienced disconnection from runway work during winter; felt mentally flat despite physical self-care routines
records.claim: Lukas Varga experienced a period of disconnection from his runway work during winter, feeling mentally flat despite maintaining physical self-care routines.

records.source_span: Lately, the travel schedule has been relentless — Berlin one night, Milan the next, Tokyo right after. I had this moment backstage last week where I panicked because I couldn't find my camera battery charger before a shoot. It turned out I'd slipped it into the cloth grocery bag I usually bring along for market runs, and it had been buried under some magazines and snacks. In the rush, my head just felt foggy.
records.value: Relentless back-to-back travel between Berlin, Milan, and Tokyo
records.claim: Lukas Varga is currently experiencing a relentless travel schedule with back-to-back shows in Berlin, Milan, and Tokyo.
